description: Test suite for PropertyValue store functions in Mattermost, including creation, retrieval, updating, deletion, and search of property values with various filters and constraints.

methods.name: TestPropertyValueStore
methods.description: Main test function executing various sub-tests for property value store operations.

methods.name: testCreatePropertyValue
methods.description: Tests creation of property values, including validation, uniqueness, and error handling.

methods.name: testCreateManyPropertyValues
methods.description: Tests batch creation of property values, handling validation, array values, and constraints.

methods.name: testGetPropertyValue
methods.description: Tests retrieval of property values by ID and groupID, including error cases.

methods.name: testGetManyPropertyValues
methods.description: Tests batch retrieval of multiple property values with various filters and error handling.

methods.name: testUpdatePropertyValue
methods.description: Tests updating property values, including validation, partial updates, and transaction rollback on errors.

methods.name: testUpsertPropertyValue
methods.description: Tests upsert operation for inserting or updating property values with validation and conflict handling.

methods.name: testDeletePropertyValue
methods.description: Tests deletion of property values, including soft delete, error cases, and re-creation.

methods.name: testSearchPropertyValues
methods.description: Tests search functionality with various filters, pagination, and inclusion of deleted values.

methods.name: testSearchPropertyValuesSince
methods.description: Tests filtering property values based on update timestamps with boundary and edge cases.

methods.name: testCreatePropertyValueWithArray
methods.description: Tests creation and update of property values containing array data.

methods.name: testDeleteForField
methods.description: Tests deletion of property values filtered by fieldID and groupID, including edge cases.

methods.name: testDeleteForTarget
methods.description: Tests deletion of property values filtered by targetID, targetType, and groupID, including error handling.
